7, Peking Road,
Shanghai.
7th November 1930.

Dear Sir,

We have been instructed by the Executor of the Will
of the late Mr. R.W. Wedderburn to apply to the Supreme Court for
Probate, and for this purpose it will be necessary to file an
affidavit setting out the circumstances of his being missed.

The best person to make this will be the Captain
of the S.S. "Dairen Maru", who is away from Shanghai at the
moment but will be back next week.

We understand that the Police have a copy of the
report made by the Captain to the Dairen Kishen Kaisha, and we
should be much obliged if you would kindly let us have a copy
of this report, in order that we may prepare the affidavit which
we shall ask the Captain to make.

We should also be obliged if you could inform us
whether any Court of Inquiry is being held by the Japanese
Consular authorities.

Yours faithfully,
Hansons.

R. C. Aiers Esq.,
Deputy Commissioner of Police.

（批：PA (cons)
? Red

1930年11月7日。

尊敬的先生：

我们受已故 R.W. 韦德伯恩先生遗嘱执行人的指示，向最高法院申请遗嘱认证，为此有必要提交一份宣誓书，陈述其失踪的情况。

最适合出具此宣誓书的人是“大连丸”号轮船的船长，他目前不在上海，但将于下周返回。

据悉，警方持有船长向大连汽船株式会社（Dairen Kishen Kaisha）所作报告的副本，如蒙惠赐该报告副本，以便我们准备拟请船长签署的宣誓书，我们将不胜感激。

此外，如能告知日本领事当局是否正在进行任何调查庭讯，我们将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼
汉森律师事务所

R. C. 艾尔斯先生（R. C. Aiers Esq.），
警务处副总监。

Subject (in full) Further enquiries into the disappearance of Mr. Wedderburn.
Made by D.S.I. Thurgood Forwarded by
Sir,
The undersigned accompanied by D.S. Kobayashi
proceeded to the S.S. Dairen Maru berthed at the Whangpoo
Wharf and ascertained the following facts:
Mr. Sato, 1st class cabin steward was questioned; he
stated that Mr. Wedderburn occupied a cabin under his charge
and that since leaving Dairen Mr. Wedderburn had not attended
any of his meals, also that he never appeared to properly
settle down. At night when he went to bed he never
properly undressed himself, or got properly into bed.
On the evening of the 31st October he served Mr. Wedderburn
with three whiskey and sodas, and that during the whole day
he understands that 8 or 9 drinks were served to him but that
Mr. Wedderburn was in no way intoxicated. At dinner time
on the evening of the 31st October when the cabin boy went
to call him for dinner Mr. Wedderburn stated that he did not
wish any dinner but that he would like some ham sandwiches.
At 7 a.m. on November 1st, the cabin boy went to Mr. Wedderburn
cabin. Mr. Wedderburn got up and left the cabin and proceeded
to the Coffee Verandah, at 8.30 a.m. this man not having
appeared for breakfast the cabin steward went to call Mr.
Wedderburn to tell him that breakfast was ready, but could
not find him anywhere so made a report to the Purser.
When questioned as to the actions of the missing man, the
cabin steward stated that he appeared like a man who was
worried and sad. Upon the ship's arrival at Tsingtau the
missing man went ashore for about one hour.
Mr. C. Takaki, Purser, stated that when the ship left
Dairen Mr. Wedderburn came to him and requested that he be

先生，
下述签署人会同警探 小林（D.S. Kobayashi）
前往停泊在黄浦码头的“大连丸”号轮船，并查明以下事实：
头等舱服务员佐藤先生（Mr. Sato）接受询问；他
陈述称，韦德伯恩先生住在其负责的舱房内，自离开大连后，韦德伯恩先生未曾用过任何一餐，且似乎从未真正安顿下来。夜间就寝时，他从未
properly undressed himself（原文如此，意为：妥善脱衣），或 properly get into bed（原文如此，意为：妥善躺好）。
10月31日晚，他为韦德伯恩先生端上了三杯威士忌苏打水，据他了解，全天共为其提供了8或9杯饮料，但韦德伯恩先生并未醉酒。10月31日晚餐时间，当侍者去叫他用餐时，韦德伯恩先生表示不想吃晚餐，但想要一些火腿三明治。
11月1日上午7时，侍者前往韦德伯恩先生的舱房。韦德伯恩先生起床离开舱房，前往咖啡廊（Coffee Verandah），上午8时30分，因该人未出现用早餐，舱房服务员前去叫醒韦德伯恩先生，告知他早餐已备好，但到处都找不到他，于是向事务长作了报告。
当被问及失踪者的行为时，舱房服务员称，他看起来像一个忧心忡忡、神情悲伤的人。轮船抵达青岛时，失踪者曾上岸约一小时。
C. 高木先生（Mr. C. Takaki），事务长，陈述称，当轮船离开大连时，韦德伯恩先生来找他，请求为他单独

alloted a cabin by himself, this was granted on payment of
Yen 20 extra. At Tsingtau a number of passengers were
transferred from the Tientsin Maru to the Dairen Maru on
account of the first named ship having been in collision.
This necessitated putting another passenger in the same
cabin as Mr.Wedderburn. This passenger was a Chinese
gentleman named "Zoh Nai Zung ( This man's name was obtained
from the passenger list, his address is not known at present)
Mr.Wedderburn strenuously objected to this, but was told by
the Purser it could not be helped. The Purser stated that he
was told by this Chinese passenger that Mr.Wedderburn did not
speak to him once and that he got up at 3.30 a.m. on the
morning of November 1st and went out. Mr. Takaki stated
that as soon as he was informed that this man was missing
he conducted a thorough search of the vessel together with
other ship's Officers but no trace was found of him and it
was presumed he had jumped overboard. On the morning
of November 1st, according to the cabin steward and Purser,
about the time Mr.Wedderburn disappeared it was raining and
rather cold, and being breakfast time would preclude other
passengers from being on deck at that time of the morning.
A copy of the Captain's report is attached to this
file.

分配一个舱房，在额外支付20日元后获准。在青岛，由于名为“天津丸”号的轮船发生碰撞事故，一批乘客从该船转移至“大连丸”号。这导致必须将另一名乘客安排在与韦德伯恩先生相同的舱房内。这名乘客是一位名叫“Zoh Nai Zung”的中国绅士（此人名取自乘客名单，目前地址不详）。韦德伯恩先生强烈反对，但事务长告知他这是无可奈何之事。事务长称，据这名中国乘客告知，韦德伯恩先生未曾与他说过一句话，且他在11月1日凌晨3时30分起床外出。高木先生陈述称，一旦得知此人失踪，他立即会同其他船员对船只进行了彻底搜查，但未发现其踪迹，推测其已跳海。据舱房服务员和事务长称，11月1日上午，大约在韦德伯恩先生失踪的时间，当时正下着雨，天气较冷，且正值早餐时间，其他乘客不太可能在那个时间段出现在甲板上。

Translation of Captain's report.

Reported by Shiro Hirao , Captain of S.S.Dairen Maru.
Case happened about 9 a.m. 1/11/30,
Longitude 122,25 degree
Latitude 31,40 "
Between Tsingtau and Shanghai.
Missing person, 1st class passenger,British Subject,male
Mr. Robert William Wedderburn, aged 46. Publisher.
The above mentioned person boarded the steamer ( No 200
voyage) from Dairen to Shanghai as a 1st class passenger.
On the 1/11/30 about 9 a.m. discovered this man missing from
the ship between Tsingtau and Shanghai. A thorough search
was made of the ship but no trace of this man could be found.
The man's effects were packed and handed over to a
Japanese Consulate Officer who came to the steamer and was
requested to take the necessary actions.
Signed: Captain of S.S. Dairen Maru.
Shiro Hirao.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.______
Wayside Station,
REPORT
Date I-II- 1930.
Subject (in full) Disappearance of Mr R.W.Wedderburn, whilst he was travelling to
Shanghai (from Dairen) by S/S Dairen Maru.
Made by D.S.Kourjansky. Forwarded by D.S.I.Thurgood
Sir,
At 7.30 p.m. I-II-30 this Station was visited by Mr A.G.
Glover of the Kelly Walsh Co Ltd, 22 Nanking Rd, who stated, that
Mr R.W.Wedderburn, British, age 46, managing director of the above
Company, was a passenger travelling to Shanghai from Dairen by the
S/S Dairen Maru, due to arrive to Shanghai at 4 p.m. I-II-30.
On arrival to Shanghai (D.K.K.Wharf) a ship was met by his friends
Mr J.H.Searly and Mr Waller, who were informed by ship's officers
that Mr R.W.Wedderburn had been missing since 8 a.m. I-II-30.
The matter was immediately conveyed by the above named persons to
Mr A.G.Glover, who reported the occurence at this Station.
He states, that Before Mr R.W.Wedderburn went on summer holidays to
Dairen (in the beginning of October 1930), he (Mr Wedderburn) had
an illusion that he was being followed by someone unknown.
Mr A.G.Glover also states, that he questioned the above ship's boy
who stated that he saw Mr R.W.Wedderburn at about 7 a.m. I-II-30
on the deck and when he went round to call him for a breakfast, he
did not find him. The whole ship was then thoroughly searched, but
no trace of him found. That was 8 hours prior to the ship's arrival
to Shanghai. Mr A.G.Glover, with the permission of captain of the
ship, was allowed to enter the missing man's cabin, to see if he
could find any letter or note, which might have been left by the
above man prior to his disappearance, but nothing was found.
All Mr R.W.Wedderburn's effects were taken in possession of captain
of the ship. The captain also informed Mr A.G.Glover, that he is go-
ing to make official report regarding the occurence and forward it
to the Authorities concerned.
Mr A.G.Glover, accompanied by D.S.I.Thurgood, visited Mr Blackburn

由 警探 库尔扬斯基（D.S. Kourjansky）呈报。由 警探长 瑟古德（D.S.I. Thurgood）转呈
先生，
1930年11月1日下午7时30分，南京路22号凯利·沃尔什有限公司（Kelly Walsh Co Ltd）的 A.G. 格洛弗先生（Mr A.G. Glover）到访本巡捕房，称该公司英籍总经理 R.W. 韦德伯恩先生，46岁，是乘坐“大连丸”号轮船从大连前往上海的乘客，该轮预计于1930年11月1日下午4时抵达上海。
轮船抵达上海（大连汽船株式会社码头）时，他的朋友 J.H. 西尔利先生（Mr J.H. Searly）和沃勒先生（Mr Waller）前去迎接，船方官员告知他们，R.W. 韦德伯恩先生自1930年11月1日上午8时起一直失踪。
上述人员立即将此情况转告 A.G. 格洛弗先生，后者向本巡捕房报告了此事。
他称，在 R.W. 韦德伯恩先生去大连度暑假之前（1930年10月初），他（韦德伯恩先生）产生了一种幻觉，觉得自己被某个不明身份的人跟踪。
A.G. 格洛弗先生还称，他询问了上述船上的侍者，侍者称在1930年11月1日上午7时许在甲板上看到 R.W. 韦德伯恩先生，当他绕过去叫韦德伯恩先生吃早餐时，发现他不在。随后对整艘船进行了彻底搜查，但未发现其踪迹。这发生在轮船抵达上海前8小时。经船长许可，A.G. 格洛弗先生获准进入失踪者的舱房，查看此人失踪前是否留下了任何信件或便条，但一无所获。
R.W. 韦德伯恩先生的所有物品均由船长保管。船长还告知 A.G. 格洛弗先生，他将就此事件制作正式报告，并送交有关当局。
A.G. 格洛弗先生在警探长瑟古德的陪同下，拜访了布莱克本先生（Mr Blackburn）
